newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-CRUYFF, VALDANO AND FERNANDEZ FAVOURITES FOR VALENCIA JOB.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CRUYFF, VALDANO AND FERNANDEZ FAVOURITES FOR VALENCIA JOB.

text.p: Three recently sacked coaches have emerged as the favourites to take over from Luis Aragones at Valencia. He announced his resignation on Tuesday after seeing his side beat Besiktas 3-1 in the UEFA Cup.
Victor Fernandez , dismissed by Zaragoza two weeks ago, has joined former Real Madrid coach Jorge Valdano and ex-Barcelona boss Johan Cruyff as the men most likely to land the job.
Reserve coach Jose Manuel Rielo will take over at Valencia as caretaker until a successor is named.
Aragones's decision to resign pre-empted a move by the Valencia board that most fans had already taken for granted after three successive league defeats.
Aragones and club president Paco Roig had clashed several times in the past few months, particularly over the decision to sign Brazilian World Cup striker Romario who has now gone back to Flamengo.
Some pundits have suggested that Romario will return to Valencia now that Aragones has gone.
Aragones, who has managed six diifferent sides since taking over at Atletico Madrid in 1974, has not talked about his own future.
